apps.title.en: Made for the way you read.

apps.description.zh:
根据硬件能力，自动选择合适的应用内置。
网络、阅读记录、相机等权限，由你管理。
apps.description.en:
Apps are automatically selected and built in to suit your hardware.
You manage access to the network, reading history, camera and more.

apps.permissionsHint.zh: 取消不想开放的权限，预览中将隐藏需要这些权限的应用。网页选择不会更改设备上的授权。
apps.permissionsHint.en: Uncheck a permission to hide apps that need it in this preview. These choices do not change permissions on your device.

apps.emptyTitle.en: No built-in apps are available with these choices.

apps.emptyText.zh: 试试其他能力，或调整允许的权限。
apps.emptyText.en: Try another capability or adjust the allowed permissions.

apps.noscript.zh: 硬件匹配与权限演示需要 JavaScript，也可以直接查看

apps.demo.en: Built-in app preview · Apps are selected automatically for the hardware, with permissions under your control. Availability follows the firmware release.

flash.title.en: A new chapter for your device.

flash.intro.zh:
无需另装刷机软件。
在桌面版 Chrome 或 Edge 中完成。
flash.intro.en:
No separate flashing software.
Use Chrome or Edge on your computer.

flash.releaseNote.zh: 当前下载为较早的开发预览版。硬件匹配的内置应用、书店与自定义菜单，以后续新版发布说明为准。公开构建
flash.releaseNote.en: Downloads are an earlier development preview. See newer release notes for hardware-matched built-in apps, the bookshop and custom menu. Pinned build

flash.initialFilter.zh: 先选择品牌，再查看对应型号。
flash.initialFilter.en: Choose a brand to see its models.

flash.testingNote.zh: 新版功能持续测试中，实测范围请查看机型说明。
flash.testingNote.en: New features are being tested. See each model’s notes for the current scope.

flash.selectNote.zh: 请核对设备的完整型号。浏览器只能核对芯片类型，无法识别同芯片的不同板型。
flash.selectNote.en: Check the exact model. Your browser can identify the chip, but not different boards using the same chip.

flash.downloads.zh: 下载文件 / 查看校验值

flash.appNote.zh: 更新镜像仅供已有兼容分区布局的同型号设备使用；首次安装请用完整镜像，并阅读发布说明。
flash.appNote.en: The update image is for the same model with a compatible partition layout. Use the full image for a first installation and read the release notes.

flash.warningStrong.zh: 完整刷写会清除设备内部的原固件和设置。
flash.warningStrong.en: A full installation erases the existing firmware and internal settings.

flash.warning.zh: 请先备份。TF 卡不会被刷写，仍建议备份书籍与应用数据；开机前插好 FAT32 格式的 TF 卡。
flash.warning.en: Back up first. The microSD card is not flashed, but back up its books and app data too. Insert a FAT32 microSD card before starting the device.

flash.ack.zh: 我已核对型号，并了解完整刷写的影响。
flash.ack.en: I have checked the model and understand the effects of a full installation.

flash.ackModel.zh: 我确认设备是 {model}，已备份并同意清除设备内部的原固件和设置。
flash.ackModel.en: I confirm this is a {model}, have made a backup, and agree to erase its existing firmware and internal settings.

flash.checkBrowser.zh: 正在检查浏览器是否支持 USB 刷写…
flash.checkBrowser.en: Checking this browser’s USB flashing support…

flash.connect.zh: 连接 USB 并开始完整刷写 ↗

flash.initialStatus.zh: 选择型号后继续。固件将从本站下载。
flash.initialStatus.en: Choose your model to continue. Firmware is downloaded from this site.

flash.helpTitle.zh: 连接不上，或不清楚怎样进入下载模式？
flash.helpTitle.en: Need help connecting or entering download mode?

flash.help1.zh: 使用可传数据的 USB 线，关闭占用串口的软件。先让工具尝试自动进入下载模式；失败后再按设备文档操作。
flash.help1.en: Use a data-capable USB cable and close any software using the serial port. Let the tool try entering download mode automatically, then follow your device’s instructions if needed.

flash.help2.zh: 请核对具体型号，并按对应文档操作。
flash.help2.en: Check your exact model and follow its documentation.

flash.noscript.zh: 网页刷机需要 JavaScript，也可以下载固件并使用本地工具。
flash.noscript.en: Web flashing needs JavaScript. You can also download firmware and use a local tool.

flash.pendingBadge.zh: 当前测试设备 · 固件待发布

flash.pendingNote.zh: 新版阅读界面正在实机测试。本站尚未收录匹配的公开固件，发布后提供下载与安装入口。
flash.pendingNote.en: The new reading interface is in hardware testing. A matching public firmware image is not yet available here. Downloads will follow its release.

flash.spec.papermono.zh: 随身阅读 · 触控与按键

flash.note.papermono.zh: 阅读、应用与聊天已实机体验。内置蜂鸣器不适合音乐播放。
flash.note.papermono.en: Reading, apps and chat have been tried on hardware. The built-in buzzer is not intended for music playback.

flash.note.papers3.zh: 显示、触摸、阅读、休眠恢复已实机体验。
flash.note.papers3.en: Display, touch, reading and sleep/resume have been tried on hardware.

flash.supported.zh: 浏览器支持 Web Serial。准备好数据线，并关闭占用设备的串口工具。
flash.supported.en: This browser supports Web Serial. Prepare a data cable and close other serial tools.

flash.unsupported.zh: 当前浏览器不支持 USB 刷写。请用电脑上的 Chrome / Edge 打开本站；你仍可下载镜像。
flash.unsupported.en: This browser does not support USB flashing. Use desktop Chrome or Edge; manual downloads are still available.

flash.readyConfirm.zh: 请确认型号与备份，再下载固件。
flash.readyConfirm.en: Confirm your model and backup before downloading.

flash.manual.zh: 已显示该机型的下载文件，可使用本地刷机工具。
flash.manual.en: Downloads for this model are available for use with a local flashing tool.

flash.newBrand.zh: 请选择该品牌的具体型号，再确认下载。
flash.newBrand.en: Choose the exact model for this brand before confirming.

flash.confirmed.zh: 已确认。下一步下载并校验固件，尚不会连接设备。
flash.confirmed.en: Confirmed. Next, download and verify the image. Your device is not connected yet.

flash.fetching.zh: 正在获取 {model} 固件，网络较慢时请稍候。
flash.fetching.en: Downloading firmware for {model}. This may take a moment.

flash.verified.zh: SHA-256 校验通过。下一步选择 USB 串口，将立即清除内部闪存并刷写。
flash.verified.en: SHA-256 verified. Selecting a USB port in the next step will erase internal flash and install the image.

flash.timeout.zh: 下载超时，请检查网络后重试。
flash.timeout.en: The download timed out. Check your connection and try again.

flash.failed.zh: 下载失败，请检查网络后重试。
flash.failed.en: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.

flash.truncated.zh: 固件下载不完整，请重新校验。
flash.truncated.en: The firmware download is incomplete. Please download and verify it again.

flash.hash.zh: 固件校验失败，已阻止刷写。请稍后重试。
flash.hash.en: Firmware checksum verification failed. Flashing has been blocked. Please try again.

flash.connecting.zh: 正在连接设备。刷写期间请勿断开 USB 或关闭页面。
flash.connecting.en: Connecting. Keep USB connected and this page open during installation.

flash.chip.zh: 已识别 {chip}，正在检查支持情况。

flash.initializing.zh: 正在进入下载模式；连接失败请参考下方说明。
flash.initializing.en: Entering download mode. See the connection instructions if it fails.

flash.preparing.zh: 正在准备已校验的固件。请保持连接。
flash.preparing.en: Preparing the verified image. Keep the device connected.

flash.erasing.zh: 正在清除设备内部闪存。请勿断开连接。
flash.erasing.en: Erasing internal flash. Do not disconnect.

flash.finished.zh: 固件已写入。请正常重启设备，再查看「应用」中的可用功能。若仍在下载模式，请按设备说明退出。
flash.finished.en: Firmware written. Restart normally and explore the available features in Apps. If still in download mode, follow the device’s instructions to exit it.

flash.failed_initialize.zh: 无法进入下载模式。请检查数据线、串口占用，并按下方说明重试。
flash.failed_initialize.en: Could not enter download mode. Check the cable, close other serial tools and follow the instructions below.

flash.not_supported.zh: 检测到不支持的芯片，已阻止刷写。请核对设备。
flash.not_supported.en: Unsupported chip detected. Flashing was blocked. Check the device model.

flash.failed_firmware_download.zh: 无法读取已校验的固件，请重新下载。
flash.failed_firmware_download.en: Could not read the verified firmware. Download it again.

flash.write_failed.zh: 写入失败。请检查连接并重新完整刷写；设备此时可能无法启动。
flash.write_failed.en: Writing failed. Check the connection and repeat the full installation. The device may not boot until it completes.

flash.flashError.zh: 刷写失败，请检查连接后重试。
flash.flashError.en: Installation failed. Check the connection and try again.

flash.cancelled.zh: 已取消选择端口，未开始刷写。
flash.cancelled.en: Port selection canceled. Installation has not started.

flash.connectionError.zh: 连接或刷写失败。请检查设备与 USB 线后重试；如已开始擦除，需要重新完整刷写。
flash.connectionError.en: Connection or installation failed. Check the USB cable and device. If erasing started, repeat the full installation.

faq.q1.zh: 书店推荐会上传我的阅读记录吗？
faq.q1.en: Does the bookshop upload my reading history?

faq.a1.zh: 个人偏好和阅读记录在设备本地参与推荐。书店从在线目录获取书籍信息，你可以调整主题、收藏想读的书，也可以减少不喜欢的内容。
faq.a1.en: Preferences and reading history are used locally on your device. The bookshop fetches book information from an online catalog. Adjust your themes, save books to your wish list, or reduce recommendations you dislike.

faq.q2.zh: 为什么不同设备内置的应用不同？
faq.q2.en: Why are different apps built into different devices?

faq.a2.zh: 系统会根据屏幕、无线通信、音频、相机等硬件能力，自动选择合适的应用内置。使用时可按应用需要管理权限；网页提供新版方案预览。
faq.a2.en: The system automatically selects built-in apps to match the display, wireless, audio, camera and other hardware capabilities. You manage the permissions each app needs. This site previews the upcoming approach.

faq.q3.zh: 应用还需要单独下载安装吗？
faq.q3.en: Do I need to download apps separately?

faq.a3.zh: 后续版本会直接内置与硬件匹配的应用，无需逐个下载安装。内置范围与更新方式以各机型的固件发布说明为准。
faq.a3.en: Future releases will include apps matched to the hardware, ready to use without separate downloads. Included apps and update methods are detailed in each model’s firmware release notes.

faq.q4.zh: 能用手机给设备安装固件吗？
faq.q4.en: Can I install firmware from my phone?

faq.a4.zh: 网页刷写需要支持 Web Serial 的桌面版 Chrome 或 Edge。手机或不支持的浏览器可下载文件，再使用电脑安装。
faq.a4.en: Web flashing requires desktop Chrome or Edge with Web Serial. You can download files on a phone or another browser, then use a computer to install them.

faq.q5.zh: 内置应用的权限如何管理？
faq.q5.en: How are permissions managed for built-in apps?

faq.a5.zh: 内置应用仍会声明所需的权限，例如网络、阅读记录、相机或照片。你可以按需授权或关闭；关闭后，需要该权限的功能将不可用。网页中的开关仅用于演示。
faq.a5.en: Built-in apps still declare the permissions they need, such as network access, reading history, camera or photos. You can allow or deny them; features that need a denied permission will be unavailable. The switches on this page are a preview only.

faq.a6.zh: 欢迎分享适合墨水屏的应用想法，或参与内置应用的开发与改进。可以查看项目代码和开发说明。
faq.a6.en: Share an app idea for e-paper, or help develop and improve the built-in apps. The project includes source code and development notes.
